strategies.summary: Identify the Judas swing, which is a fake move before the real expansion, at the start of a session, day, or week. Enter on this retracement into a FLOT or LOT to ride the real expansion towards the higher timeframe draw on liquidity.

timeframes.notes: Higher timeframe (e.g., 4H or Daily) sets the draw on liquidity and POI. The 15m is used to identify the FLOT/LOT. The 1m or 5m is used for entry, though 1m can be deceptive without higher timeframe context.

glossary.Judas Swing: The fake move before the real move, designed to trick people into the market.
glossary.FLOT: First line of defense, which is most of the time a fair value gap.
glossary.LOT: Last line of defense, the opposing swing low/high.

custom_signals.name: Equities Open Judas
custom_signals.plain_definition: A volatile fake move sweeping liquidity at 08:30 or 09:30 NY time on indices.

sequence: Identify the higher timeframe draw on liquidity and the premium/discount arrays (FLOT and LOT) on the setup timeframe.
Wait for the start of a session, day, or week.
Observe a counter-trend fake move (Judas swing) that reaches into the FLOT (typically an FVG) or sweeps liquidity.
Get involved in this retracement to ride the true expansion towards the higher timeframe target.

invalidation.text: If there is a fair value gap in the leg (FLOT), price should respect it and likely not sweep the LOT.
The Judas swing should not come back below the LOT.

filters.text: Do not expect the Judas swing to sweep an unreasonable amount of liquidity outside the average daily volatility.
Be cautious on days with no economic calendar news events (like some Mondays), as price might lack the energy to expand.

entry_rule.text: Get involved in the retracement (the fake move) as it reaches into the FLOT or LOT.
entry_rule.quote: when you have that retracement you want to get involved here to write that expansion

target_rule.text: Target the higher timeframe draw on liquidity, such as the first opposing discount/premium array.
target_rule.quote: what is the first discount array that we cannot reach for it it is this swing low

stop_rule.text: Place the stop loss beyond the LOT (Last Line of Defense).
stop_rule.quote: it shouldn't come back below this low it should not sweep this low

strategies.notes: Traidle requires an FVG to be mitigated at the CE (midpoint), but the presenter implies that merely reaching into the FVG (FLOT) is sufficient. Therefore, traidle_supported is flagged as false for the FVG mitigation step.

confidence.reason: The transcript clearly outlines the conceptual framework of the Judas swing, FLOT/LOT usage, and invalidation rules, though it lacks an explicit mechanical trigger.

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: The New York session begins, initiating a counter-trend Judas Swing.
The fake move trades directly into the First Line of Defense (FLOT), which is a Fair Value Gap.
Price respects the FLOT FVG without sweeping the Last Line of Defense (LOT) and subsequently expands in the true direction.
